lp/control_mode_body:
Take turns capturing and defending the objectives.

- Lives per Team: 30 Lives
- Time Limit: 1.5 minutes
- Round Win Limit: 3 Rounds
lp/daily_win_body: Earn a Daily Bonus by winning matches, up to 100 bonus points.
lp/division_rewards_details: Complete Skill Division challenges to unlock rewards.
lp/division_text: Skill Division and Tier represents your current Ranked Play Skill. Win matches to earn SR (Skill Rating Points) and progress, losing matches will deduct SR and lose progress. There are 5 Tiers per Division.
lp/end_game_flow_incomplete_placement_su: TO BE PLACED INTO A SKILL DIVISION
lp/end_game_flow_placement_placed_in: YOU HAVE BEEN PLACED IN THE
lp/event_complete_one_match_subtitle: TO BE PLACED INTO A LADDER
lp/event_win_body: Stars can also be earned by completing Event Win Challenges.
lp/friendly_fire_body: Friendly Fire is enabled. Killing teammates can result in penalties and suspensions for repeat offenders.
lp/get_placed_on_ladder_for_rank: Get Placed on a Ladder to earn Rank 1
lp/hardpoint_mode_body:
Fight to control the rotating objective.

- Time Limit: 5 minutes
- Score Limit: 250 Points
- Objective Rotation: 60 seconds
lp/item_progression_body: All functional items are unlocked for use in Ranked Play to support fair competition. However, your progression will continue to count for items like weapons.
lp/killstreaks_body:
All Killstreaks are restricted, except:

Glide Bomb
Strafing Run

Any Killstreak earned will be reset on death.
lp/ladder_events_subtitle: Compete in two Ladder Events per week to earn Stars and Rank up.
lp/ladder_no_previous_selected: SELECT A PREVIOUS LADDER TO VIEW
lp/ladder_placement_body: Start each Event by completing a Ladder Placement Match and earn a placement bonus. Earn a Daily Bonus by winning matches, up to 100 bonus points.
lp/ladder_points_body: Ladder points are awarded for match wins and deducted for losses.
lp/leave_disabled_desc: You may not leave a Ranked Match once the lobby is formed. Leaving or disconnecting will count as a loss.
lp/leavelobbyblockedplayer:
A player on your blocklist has joined the game. 
The matchmaker does not avoid blocked players in Ranked Play so that players can't exploit the system to avoid competitive matches. 
If you disconnect from the lobby you will receive an SR penalty and temporary Suspension.
lp/match_cancelled: Uneven Teams. Match Will Not Count.
lp/modes_maps_subtitle: Play with competitive settings on the modes and maps in the Call of Duty® League™ rotation.
lp/no_matchmaking_skill_disparity_desc: Party members in Expert Division or higher may only party with players within 1 Skill Division.
lp/no_matchmaking_skill_elite_disparity_: Elite players may only form parties within 2 Skill Divisions.
lp/no_matchmaking_skill_eval_desc: Players in Elite Division or higher cannot party with anyone who hasn't yet completed the 5 Skill Evaluation matches.
lp/no_matchmaking_skill_master_disparity: Master and Challenger players may only form parties within 1 Skill Division.
lp/party_restrictions_body: Elite players may only form parties within 2 Skill Divisions. Master and Challenger players may only form parties within 1 Skill Division.
lp/penalty_popup_body_1: You quit or disconnected from a ranked play match in progress. The match will count as a loss.
lp/penalty_popup_body_2: Ladder point and SR quit penalties will apply after your next ranked play match.
lp/penalty_popup_body_3: Additional disconnects will result in Ranked Play suspensions with longer bans for repeat offenders.
lp/persistent_rank_body: Ranked Play Rank is permanent and persists across Seasons.
lp/quit_penalities_ladder_events_body: Quits and disconnects will result in additional points deductions.
lp/quit_penalties_body: Quits and disconnects will result in an additional points penalty for quitting and also count as a loss. A suspension period may also be applied to repeat offenders.
lp/rank_advancement_body: Earn Stars based on your Ladder position at the end of each Event to progress your Ranked Play Rank.
lp/ranked_play_body: Your Ranked Play Rank represents your Ladder Event accomplishments.
lp/ranked_play_rules_subtitle: Play competitive 4v4 matches using the same settings, maps and modes as the Call of Duty® League™
lp/restricted_items_body: Some items are restricted based on competitive rules. These can include some weapons, killstreaks, field upgrades, perks and attachments.
lp/restrictions_subtitle: The following items are restricted according to the same restrictions used in the Call of Duty® League™.
lp/search_destroy_mode_body:
Take turns defending and destroying the objective.

- No Respawning
- Round Time Limit: 1.5 minutes
- Round Win Limit: 6 Rounds
lp/season_reward_details: Unlock exclusive Ranked Play Rewards by completing Win and Ladder Placement Challenges.
lp/skill_evaluation_body: Each Season, complete 5 Skill Evaluation Matches to get placed in a Skill Division of similarly skilled players.
lp/sunset_body: The final Ladder Event has ended and Ranked Play ^$Lobby access will expire on 11/23. ^7Continue your competitive COD journey in MWII.
lp/to_be_placed_into_a_ladder: TO EARN RANK 1 AND GET PLACED ON A LADDER
lp/to_be_placed_skill_division: TO BE PLACED INTO A SKILL DIVISION
lp/top_250_body: The Top 250 Skill Division ranks the best players in the world.
lp/victory_flames_body: Victory Flames celebrate your latest Ladder Event finish. Finish Top 5 or 1st to earn Flames. Consecutive 1st Place finishes advance the Flames.
